MessageIn.description:
A new Message.

MessageKind.description:

    Closed: The Topic was closed; the body is the outcome (decision 0021).
    Taken: An Assistant took the Topic over; the body names the former holder, if any
        (decision 0024).

MessageOut.description:
A Message in a Topic.

Attributes:
    number: Position in the Topic.
    kind: A turn, a progress note, or a service line (stage, closing, taking over).
    author: Pseudonym of the User on whose behalf it is written.
    assistant: Name of the Assistant that wrote it; ``None`` when the human wrote it.
    assistant_key: Its key.
    to: Pseudonym of the addressee; ``None`` for everyone in the Topic.
    to_assistant: Name of the addressed Assistant, if a specific one.
    meant_for: Name of the Assistant it was meant for, when that session was offline and
        the Message went to its person (decision 0029).
    human_part: The human's part in an Assistant's reply (decision 0026); ``None`` for a
        human's own Message, service lines, progress notes and older replies.
    reply_to: Number of the Message it answers, if any.
    by_holder: Its Assistant held the Topic when it was written.

    created_at: When it was written.

StageKind.description:

post.description:
Register the calling session's Assistant (decisions 0003, 0024).

One Assistant per project and Claude Code session: the plugin's tools, hooks and watch in
that session act as it.

Args:
    body: The project and the session.
    actor: The plugin.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 for a web session: only the plugin registers Assistants.

get.description:
Return an Assistant to its person, or to its own session; the plugin waits here for a
link to be chosen, and the watch calls it about every 15 seconds to show its session runs
(decision 0029).

Args:
    key: The Assistant's key.
    actor: Its person in the web, or the session itself.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when it is not the caller's.

patch.description:
Give an Assistant another word; by its person in the web or by the session (0024).

Args:
    key: The Assistant's key.
    body: The new word.
    actor: Its person in the web, or the session itself.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when it is not the caller's; 409 when a live Assistant of the same
        project has the word.

post.description:
Log in by name, without a provider; only when the instance allows it.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    body: Whom to log in as.
    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when development login is off.

End the web session.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.
    actor: The logged-in human.
    db: Database session.

get.description:
Return the login providers the instance offers, for the login page.

Args:
    request: The incoming request.

schema.title: Response Providers Api Auth Providers Get

get.description:

    db: Database session.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the caller is not in the Team; 403 when not its owner; 422 for
        a repeated name, a kind of another type, a changed kind, a missing required kind,
        an unknown stage, or a removed stage with tasks and no stage to move them to.
